notes.title: v1.1.0 UPDATE！！！Fix Shop Bug and many more！
notes.notes:
Thank you a lot for your support to improve our game better. We would like to announce a landmark update - v1.1.0. The game flow, features have been improved a lot in this version as well as some critical bugs have been fixed.
[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed shop bug resulting Russian players cannot go to shop.
[*] Added Gallery for based-game.
[*] Added Newgame Confirmation.
[*] Fixed BGM not save.
[*] Added HP low warning when Player health is lower than 35%. At the same time, the girl will also receive damage when Player HP is low (He is failed to protect her, so sad)
[*] Improved Girl interaction in battle, help player to unlock all girl's information easier.
[*] Added option to not display girl skill animation in battle's setting.
[*] Fixed other minor bugs.
[/list]

We heard that many people feedback found late-game user experience is not entertaining enough. Therefore, we planned to add more content logic to the game, such as new cards, infinity dungeon and many more. We're all looking to hear your idea and opinion to make the game more enjoyable. Cheer!
